Fixed. On the Products page, the "New" and "Sale" badges were positioned 10px outside the card (`top: -10px; right: -10px`), but `.card` has `overflow: hidden` (for the rounded thumbnail), so most of each tag was clipped — only a sliver showed in the card's corner.

**Change** — `site/css/components.css:171`:
```css
.badge {
  position: absolute;
  top: var(--space-3);   /* was -10px */
  right: var(--space-3); /* was -10px */
```
The badges now sit fully inside the top-right corner of the thumbnail, using the existing spacing token.

Verified by re-rendering the page at desktop (1280px) and mobile (390px) widths — both badges are fully visible with no horizontal overflow — and all 16 functional tests pass.
